prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game RIGGING TEXTURE ATLAS. Create a portrait PNG sprite sheet, 1024 wide by 1536 tall, exactly TWO columns by THREE rows of 512x512 cells. Transparent background everywhere outside the isolated sprites. No boat hull, no water, no labels, no text, no borders, no drop shadows. Strict orthographic TOP DOWN view for hardware; only ambient shading painted inside each object. Every cell has generous transparent margins and objects must not cross cell boundaries. All materials have authored brushwork, rich material detail, cohesive lighting and confident outlines, clearly finished game art rather than diagrams.
Layout REQUIRED:
TOP LEFT CELL: an attractive wooden dinghy rudder head and tiller assembly viewed straight down. Horizontal, a rounded narrow varnished wooden rudder head extends LEFT, a long gracefully tapered curved wood tiller extends RIGHT. Bronze pivot/hinge at the exact CENTER of the cell. Rudder blade left to x60; tiller right to x475. Rich wood grain and bronze pins, small teal painted inset, warm highlights, dark contoured edge. A compact organic boat fitting, not a rectangular paddle or an oar.
TOP RIGHT CELL: circular top-down wooden mast cap and bronze mast collar, concentric visible timber end-grain, warm rim highlights, three little bronze eyelets around perimeter. Centered circular silhouette, about 300 pixels diameter. No long vertical mast, no side view.
MIDDLE LEFT CELL: THREE separate isolated horizontal fittings, vertically stacked with ample gaps: at y90 a small varnished wood cheek PULLEY BLOCK with visible bronze sheave and rope hole; at y250 a bronze two-horn deck CLEAT on an oval wooden backing plate with two attachment screws; at y415 a straight long slender WOODEN BOOM spar, approximately 400px long and 24px thick, rounded left mast attachment and tapered right tip, visible grain, small bronze end fitting. Each of these three must be separate on transparency.
MIDDLE RIGHT CELL: one straight horizontal segment of braided warm hemp ROPE, long left-to-right, thick enough to clearly see individual twisted fibers, about 420 pixels long and 64 pixels thick. Consistent thickness, squared off cut ends. Transparent around rope, no coil or knots.
BOTTOM LEFT CELL: one flat RECTANGULAR CREAM SAILCLOTH TEXTURE SWATCH, 440px square, nearly white ivory with subtle painted woven linen grain, three broad sewn panels, readable soft ochre stitches and reinforced hems. Even illumination with no geometric folds or external shadow. It will be deformed by the game, so it must be a flat cloth material patch, not a triangular sail illustration.
BOTTOM RIGHT CELL: one horizontal tapered red-and-ivory striped WINDSOCK, mouth on LEFT, free tail on RIGHT, five alternating coral/ivory bands. Paint expressive soft cloth ridges, stitched seams, woven fabric, a simple bronze mouth hoop. A mostly straight, fully inflated top-down cloth tube to be deformed by the game; no support pole. About 420px long, mouth height 120px narrowing to 30px at tail. Transparent outside its outline.
Style: semi-stylized painterly honey oak and weathered teak, subdued turquoise, warm bronze, cream linen, warm dark walnut contours. Rich but restrained brush texture and edge highlights, natural gentle shading.
